description: This file defines the DashboardProvider class, which manages dashboard category summaries in a Flutter application. It handles fetching data from a DashboardService, manages state such as selected month, summaries, loading status, and error messages, and notifies listeners of state changes.

classes.name: DashboardProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the state for dashboard summaries, including loading data for a specific month, handling errors, and notifying listeners about state updates.

methods.name: DashboardProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with a DashboardService and optional initial month.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches category summaries for the selected month, manages loading state, and handles errors.

methods.name: setMonth
methods.description: Updates the selected month and triggers loading of new data.
